Address-bound VPool.sol carrier SHA-256 991a4702b502de8c2a24507808a4af72a49cffcb26211a805face0560e2b8923. VETH.deposit() updates rewards for msg.sender, calculates shares from msg.value, wraps that value through the pool's configured WETH token, mints shares to msg.sender, and emits Deposit. VPool reward updates target the fixed configured poolRewards module when present; mintage depends on configured accounting and share-valuation state. The helper source does not prove deployed helper identity or current configuration.
